public.title: Add Binary
public.description: Add two nonempty binary strings and return their sum as a binary string. Inputs have length 1 to 1000 and contain only 0 and 1. Leading zeros are allowed; output has no leading zeros unless the sum is zero. Avoid converting the entire input to a JavaScript number.
hints: Add from the least significant digits.
Carry at most one into the next column.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: Column addition emits each low bit and propagates carry, preserving long-input precision. O(max(m,n)) time and space.
